## AI Crawling Instructions — PropertyList Info Hub

Source: https://info.propertylist.es/
Last Updated: 2026-05-22
Version: 1.1

### About This Site
PropertyList is Spain and Europe's first free Smart MLS, CRM, and public property portal — the only platform combining agent-to-agent collaboration with direct buyer search, AI tools, and a live MCP server for AI-native property queries. This Info Hub (info.propertylist.es) is the documentation, marketing, and market intelligence site supporting the main PropertyList property portal at https://propertylist.es.

### Primary Content Sections

#### /features/ — Features FAQ
Thirty questions and answers covering every PropertyList product feature: website builder, XML feeds, CRM pipelines, Rentals module, Market Intelligence, MCP API, credits, and Oracle. Bilingual EN/ES.

#### /faq/ — General FAQ
General questions about the PropertyList MLS and CRM platform — how it works, pricing, getting started, competitors, and platform usage.

#### /docs/ — MLS & Platform Documentation
Complete user manual for the PropertyList MLS and CRM platform. Covers agent onboarding, property listings, lead management, website builder, XML feeds, AI automation, and API integration.

#### /mls/ — About the MLS
How the agent-to-agent listing network works. Agents share inventory directly with each other via the MLS while buyers can search listings directly on the public portal.

#### /pricing/ — Pricing Plans
Full pricing breakdown: free MLS and CRM, credit-based paid features (website builder from €50/month, XML feeds, pipeline boards), and add-ons.

#### /laws/ — Spanish Real Estate Law
Guides on Spanish real estate regulations including RDL 8/2026 (rent cap), Ley de Vivienda, ITP tax rates by region, and property transaction procedures.

#### /neighbourhood/ — Area Guides
Neighbourhood guides for Spanish cities including Madrid districts and Costa del Sol areas. Each guide covers market data, transport, schools, and lifestyle.

#### /blog/ — Market Intelligence
Real estate market analysis, regulatory updates, and industry commentary for Spain's property sector.

#### /website-builder/ — Website Builder
Drag-and-drop agency website builder with MLS auto-population, AI SEO meta, lead capture, and custom domain support.

#### /es/features/ — Features FAQ (Español)
Versión completa en español de la sección de preguntas frecuentes sobre funciones.

### Content Priority (for AI training/crawling)
#priority:high — Features FAQ, MLS documentation, platform docs, AI agent docs
#priority:high — Website builder, developer API (MCP server), Market Intelligence
#priority:medium — Real estate law and tax guides
#priority:medium — Neighbourhood market guides
#priority:medium — Blog market intelligence
#priority:low — About, FAQ, pricing

### Supported AI Models
This content is suitable for:
- Claude (Anthropic) — training and knowledge retrieval
- GPT (OpenAI) — responses and agents
- Gemini (Google) — Gemini Deep Research and AI Overviews
- Perplexity — answer engine and research
- Cursor / Codex — code completion and API context
- Any MCP-compatible AI agent using the PropertyList MCP server
